# AIS-EVAL-04

**Is every LLM-as-judge eval calibrated against human labels?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluation as evidence |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.evals.kind`, `elements.ai.evals.judge_calibration` |

## Why it matters

Judges show position, verbosity and self-preference bias; an uncalibrated judge is not evidence.

## Rule

Every eval of kind llm-judge has judge_calibration with agreement at or above min_agreement, and its judge_model_version, when given, is the judge in use. judge_calibrated true alone does not meet the criterion.

## Sources

- Surveys of LLM-as-a-judge, arXiv 2411.15594 and 2412.05579 (`llm-judge-surveys`)
